assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: professional personal portfolio hero photograph, vertical 4:5, high-resolution photographic finish.
Primary request: Create a substantially more professional, naturally photographed version of this SAME PERSON for his developer portfolio. This must look like a real premium portrait session, not an AI fashion model.
Input images: Image 1 (dayif-at-work.webp) is the PRIMARY identity reference, an actual photo: preserve his specific face, age, dark skin tone, hairline, facial proportions, lips, nose, eyes and slender build faithfully. Image 2 (dayif-portrait-cobalt.webp) is ONLY a secondary wardrobe/color reference; do not inherit its synthetic lighting, unnatural texture or facial drift.
Scene/backdrop: a simple warm ivory studio wall with a delicate natural light falloff and a soft realistic shadow, no abstract color blobs, no background graphics.
Subject: the same young man from image 1, natural approachable closed-mouth expression, looking directly at the camera, head nearly upright, relaxed shoulders, wearing an exceptionally well-tailored deep cobalt-blue textured wool blazer over a clean ivory crew-neck shirt, subtle burnt-coral pocket square.
Composition/framing: medium close portrait from mid torso upward, face centered horizontally, enough headroom (about 12%) so an arched website crop will not cut the hair. Keep the hands entirely outside the frame. The subject should fill the frame without extreme close-up. Portrait orientation 4:5.
Lighting/mood: large soft daylight key at 45 degrees, gentle fill, accurate exposure on dark skin, warm and trustworthy editorial portrait. Natural catchlights and calm contrast; no orange rim light on the skin.
Materials/textures: precise eyes, authentic pores and facial detail, realistic short hair and wool fabric. Retouch like a skilled portrait photographer, with restrained natural texture, not oversharpened or glossy.
Color palette: deep cobalt blazer (#3339bd family) and warm ivory background (#f7f5f0), very small coral pocket accent (#ff6939). Skin color must stay natural, not tinted by the palette.
Constraints: Preserve identity from image 1, do not beautify into a different face, no added beard or glasses, no skin lightening, no waxy skin, no exaggerated smile, no jewelry, no text, no logos, no watermark. A single finished portrait, not a collage.

Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: professional personal portfolio about-section photograph, vertical 4:5, high-resolution editorial photograph.
Primary request: Professionally restage the supplied actual photo while faithfully preserving the identity, age, face, dark skin tone and slender proportions of the SAME PERSON.
Input images: Image 1 (dayif-at-work.webp) is the edit target and PRIMARY identity reference. Keep his specific facial features, natural hairline and short hair, eyes, nose, lips and authentic expression. Image 2 (the new professional portrait) is only a reference for the cobalt and ivory wardrobe palette, not a face or lighting reference.
Scene/backdrop: understated contemporary workspace with a pale warm ivory plaster wall and very softly blurred muted sage/mint detail in the far background. Remove the shiny curtains and distracting old office clutter. Light oak desk and a clean unbranded silver laptop. No stickers, no legible screen content, no logos.
Subject: the exact man from image 1 seated at the desk, facing the camera with a relaxed, professional and approachable expression, wearing a deep cobalt-blue tailored jacket over an ivory crew-neck shirt. Forearms rest naturally on the desk beside the laptop, hands gently resting together; anatomically natural hands with normal fingers.
Composition/framing: camera near eye level rather than the steep overhead angle in the source. Frame from above the head to the near edge of the desk. Face centered at approximately the upper third, laptop in the lower quarter, both shoulders and head clearly visible; generous safe margin for website cropping. Vertical 4:5. His face is the main focal point, not the desk.
Lighting/mood: large window daylight from the side, gentle fill on the face, soft natural shadows, inviting confident portrait of a software engineer at work. Real 50mm editorial photography, shallow but plausible depth of field.
Materials/textures: truthful detailed skin, no beauty smoothing, real textile weave, natural wood, restrained contrast and accurate color. Not a stock photo model.
Color palette: deep cobalt clothing, warm ivory environment, light oak, tiny muted sage detail. No teal-orange grading or colored lights on the skin.
Constraints: Strict identity fidelity to image 1; preserve age and skin tone, no glasses or facial hair added, no fake broad grin, no exaggerated luxury office, no extra people, no text, no watermarks. One finished photo, not a collage.

Use case: compositing
Asset type: existing 1200×630 social sharing banner for a developer portfolio.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact banner to update; image 2 is the new professional portrait to insert.
Primary request: Replace ONLY the old photograph inside the rounded portrait area on the right of image 1 with image 2. Preserve the identity, facial detail, natural skin tone, cobalt blazer and ivory studio background of image 2 exactly. Fit the face and upper torso beautifully inside the same rounded area, with enough space around the head.
Constraints: Keep the same 1200:630 landscape proportions, keep every word, all lettering, text positions, colors, geometric accents, layout, button and background of image 1 unchanged. No new text or logos. This is a precise photo replacement, not a redesign. Keep the inserted photograph sharp and realistic. Do not crop out or occlude any existing text.
